messages:
ellie: hey folks — opening a docs PR that adds a small cookbook for private/VPC installs where KMS keys are tenant-scoped. includes cert chain ordering, example systemd unit snippet, and notes about HSM binding. pinging security + sdk for a quick look. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/4821 :eyes:
ben: thanks — can you call out the case where the customer provides an external cert chain vs using the installer-generated CA? we had a customer hit that last week.
sam: re: HSM binding — is this the same mapping we documented in the migration guide or a different flow?
ellie: good q. it's slightly different: migration guide covers moving keys between HSM clusters; this is per-tenant KMS key association (same HSM but tenant-level policy). adding a short diagram and a JSON example of the binding.
rachel: can you paste the systemd snippet here? i'll sanity-check the unit flags for cert paths and env vars.
ellie: sure — minimal example:
```
[Unit]
Description=redwood-kms-proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
Environment=REDWOOD_CERT_PATH=/etc/redwood/certs/tenant-chain.pem
Environment=REDWOOD_KEYSTORE=/var/lib/redwood/keystore/tenant.pkcs11
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-kms-proxy --bind=0.0.0.0:8443
Restart=on-failure
```
ben: looks good. call out permission bits on the keystore and that the installer runs as `redwood` user. also mention SELinux label on RHEL/CentOS.
matt: sdk folks — do we need to update the node/python snippets for tenant-scoped KMS? otherwise callers might try the global key path.
priya: i'll add a short blurb in the SDK readme (python & node) — can you point to the exact config key name?
ellie: config key is `kms.tenant_binding` (boolean) and `kms.tenant_id` (string). when true, the proxy will append the tenant id to the kms key path. i'll add examples.
rachel: added two nit comments in the PR about wording in the troubleshooting section. small wording fix.
docs-bot: CI link: https://ci.redwood/docs/4821/checks — linkcheck failed on one internal link.
ellie: thanks — fixing the link now (was pointing to old /install page).
sam: quick question — for air-gapped installs, do we want to recommend bundling the PKCS#11 driver in the offline tarball or leave as external dependency?
ellie: recommend bundling the driver when possible (we provide instructions for packaging), but call out licensing caveats. i'll add a short paragraph under 'airgapped notes'.
ben: once docs updated, can we mark the migration playbook to reference this page (customers migrating to tenant-scoped keys should follow both guides).
ellie: yup — i'll add a cross-ref. aiming to merge after sdk blurb review. target EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
priya: i'll review the SDK blurb first thing tomorrow morning.
matt: 👍 will check the example responses from the SDK — make sure error codes for AccessDenied vs KeyNotFound are clearly documented.
ellie: great, thanks all. closing loop after SDK + sec review.
